sections.content_text: Section 84 - Computation of Income of approved Tax Holiday Entity (1) The income of approved tax exempted entity shall be calculated separately from any other business. (2) The income of the approved tax exempted entity shall be computed in the same manner as the income of the “Income from Business” category. (3) Only the general depreciation allowance mentioned in Part I of the Third Schedule shall be applicable in computing the income from business of an approved tax exempted entity. (4) The computed loss of an approved tax exempted entity for any income year shall not be set off against the profits of any other entity or sector of the taxpayer, which is not an approved tax exempted entity. (5) The benefit of tax holiday shall not be applicable to the income arising from the said entity as a result of disallowance under section 55 and such income shall be taxed at the regular rate.
